title: Machine Safety
note: UK machinery safety law and the harmonised standards used under it (ISO 12100, ISO 13849, ISO 14119, ISO 14120, ISO 13855, IEC 61800-5-2). The standards are summarised, not reproduced: read the real ones before you design.

lessons.title: The law: HSWA, PUWER, the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations, UKCA and CE
Risk assessment to ISO 12100: hazards and the order of risk reduction
RAMS, permits to work and lock-out
Guards and interlocks: ISO 14119, ISO 14120, safety distances (ISO 13855)
Safety PLCs and drive safety functions: STO, SS1, SLS (IEC 61800-5-2)
Validating safety functions: ISO 13849-2 and SISTEMA
